scope: Public 315-destination selected-cell catalogue for the 1991-2025 historical period

supersededSemantics.reason: A single composite number mixes temporal completeness, elevation alignment, interannual variability and spatial representativeness. Capping every selected-cell record at 64 does not communicate which limitation exists and makes complete 35-year records appear uniformly low quality.

temporalDataQuality.failurePolicy: Withhold affected metric, score and recommendation; do not publish a lower confidence number as a substitute for missing evidence.

verifiedRequirements: canonical source and observation hashes retained
consolidated ERA5-Land rather than preliminary ERA5-Land-T

spatialScope.requiredClaim: Historical conditions at one selected ERA5-Land model cell; not a whole-destination or route-specific average.

routeRepresentativeness.supportedRequirement: Independent route geometry or equivalent official evidence intersects the selected model cell and is recorded in provenance.
routeRepresentativeness.claimPolicy: A not-assessed value permits selected-cell climatology only and prohibits whole-destination or route-specific claims.

elevationAlignment.publication: Publish the selected cell model elevation and the documented destination or route elevation context directly.

recommendationAndRanking.dataQualityGate: Only complete and source-verified records may receive a score or recommendation.
recommendationAndRanking.spatialScopeGate: Selected-cell scope is expressed as provenance and a claim restriction, not as a numeric confidence penalty.

wind.rule: Unvalidated ERA5-Land 10 m grid wind remains excluded from evidence-quality decisions and must not be presented as exposed-trail or gust evidence.

legacyMigration.temporaryInternalDiagnosticAllowed: The old raw composite may be retained only in a non-public migration comparison and must not affect scores, rankings, recommendations, indexability or user-facing copy.
legacyMigration.publicSchemaPolicy: Do not expose the legacy numeric confidence fields in newly generated public destination, ranking or search files.
